note: Both sets capture the core member sizes (2"x8" joist/frame, 3/4"x5 1/2" plywood deck and reclaimed wood surface, 3/8"x4" hex through bolt) and the 2'-4" first-floor-to-grade elevation. Set A, however, adds several unsupported or misbound claims: an invented 'overhang (left)' attribute for 4 1/4", an invented 'horizontal offset 1' condition for 1 1/2", a fabricated entity 'component E', the 1" nut dimension misbound to 'nut sleeve' (SLEVE is a separate label), and 3 1/2"/1'-0" attributed to 'C1 DECKING' when those dimensions belong to the B1 connection detail. Set B is cleaner, correctly splitting the 3/8"x4" bolt into length 4" and diameter 3/8" and adding the 3/4" threaded rod, though it repeats vague 'component 1' claims and also misassigns 8'-0" (a C3 footing-elevation dimension) to the decking footing plan. Both sets share the 8'-0" and 'C1 DECKING 3 1/2"' errors, but Set A accumulates more invented conditions and misbindings overall.
